name: Corporate email pattern discovery and employee directory analysis
topic: Corporate email pattern discovery and employee directory analysis
description: Corporate email pattern discovery and employee directory analysis -- a easy-tier osint challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Corporate email pattern discovery and employee directory analysis"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is a hex-encoded XOR cipher (4-byte repeating key). Brute-force or crib-drag with the known flag prefix.
